title: 지정재판부의 구성과 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text: Article 4 (Presiding Justice) The presiding Justice of each Panel shall be the Justice in the column immediately preceding that of the Justice assigned as rapporteur: Provided, That where the Justice in Column Ga is the rapporteur, the Justice in Column Da shall preside. The presiding Justice of Panel No. 1, however, shall be the President of the Constitutional Court.
